## Summary
<!-- What does this PR do and why? -->

## Type of change
- [ ] feat (new feature)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)
- [ ] docs / ci / chore / test / refactor

## Checklist
- [ ] PR title follows `type: short description` (e.g. `feat: add /health route`)
- [ ] Branch name follows `feature/*`, `bugfix/*`, or `hotfix/*`
- [ ] `flake8 .` and `pytest` pass locally
- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] At least one reviewer approved
